CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE, 1908: c s. 35(1), CPC read with Chapters 11, 5 and 23 of Delhi High Coult Rules - Costs - Appeal against vacating of an interim order - Dismissed by High Coult with costs of Rs. 45, 28, 0001- - Appeal to Supreme Coult confined only to legality and validity of order of costs - 0 The Court also referred to the larger question of costs in civil litigation - The Law Commission of India also intervened - Notices were also issued to High Coutts to ascerlain the Rules and procedures in force in regard to costs - HELD: High Court could not have awarded costs
